title: Plant Nuclei Enrichment for Chromatin Capture-Based Hi-C Library Protocols
author: Elena Hilario
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8vehw3e
materials: Discard the supernatant . Retrieve the nuclei pellet by adding ~ 500 μL NEB-A and gently resuspend it with a wide bore pipette tip. Transfer it to a 1.5 mL screw-capped tube. Add another ~ 500 μL NEB-A to the Falcon tube to retrieve any remaining nuclei and transfer it to the screw-capped tube. Make sure the solution is homogeneous. Transfer half of it to another 1.5 mL screw-capped tube and add enough NEB-A to each tube to have a final volume of 1 mL. Collect the nuclei by centrifugation 5200 rpm, Enriched nuclei sample 00:02:00, Enriched nuclei sample Room temperature . Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare Leaf Samples
steps.instruction: Weight 1-2 g of young leaves, either fresh or frozen.

steps.title: Pre-cool Mortar and Pestle
steps.instruction: Pre-cool the mortar and pestle by pouring liquid nitrogen to the rim of the mortar. Once the liquid nitrogen is evaporated, repeat the pre-cooling step.

steps.title: Grind Leaves to Fine Powder
steps.instruction: Freeze and grind the leaves using liquid nitrogen until a fine powder resembling icing sugar is obtained.

substeps.instruction: Add leaves to the mortar and pour liquid nitrogen over them to freeze immediately (crush slightly if needed to fit).
Once liquid nitrogen evaporates, grind with a circular motion and by pushing from the rim to the center.
Retrieve powder from the pestle with a pre-cooled spatula.
Add more liquid nitrogen and repeat until a fine powder is obtained (typically 3 rounds of grinding).

steps.title: Perform Organellar Lysis
steps.instruction: Dissolve the leaf powder in NEB-complete +Triton X100 and lyse at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the powder to a beaker containing 50 mL of NEB-complete +Triton X100.
Stir at moderate speed until all powder is dissolved, breaking large clumps with a spatula against the beaker's internal wall.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 4 °C in an ice box on a magnetic stirring plate.

steps.title: Filter and Collect Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the lysate and pellet the nuclei via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Filtrate the sample through a Miracloth sheet, carefully pipetting the extract in the funnel to detach residue.
Centrifuge at 1800 x g for 15 minutes at 10 °C.
Discard the supernatant according to institutional waste guidelines.

steps.title: Wash Nuclei with NEB-βME
steps.instruction: Wash the nuclei pellet using NEB-βME.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 mL NEB-βME to the pellet.
Resuspend gently by inverting the tube in a rocking movement.
Collect the nuclei by centrifugation (refer to centrifugation parameters in step 5).

steps.title: Homogenize Nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend and homogenize the nuclei using a Dounce homogenizer on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 7 mL of NEB-A buffer to the pellet and resuspend gently.
Transfer the mixture to a Dounce homogenizer and place on an ice box.
Use the 'B' pestle to homogenize by pulling and pushing very gently, avoiding lifting the pestle out of the liquid or creating bubbles.

steps.title: Perform Sequential Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenized extract through a series of strainers.

substeps.instruction: Assemble a 100 μm strainer on a 50 mL Falcon tube and transfer the filtrated extract to the strainer.
Assemble a 40 μm strainer on a 50 mL Falcon tube and transfer the extract; this may take about 10 min.
Place the assembled tube on ice.
If necessary, assist filtration by pipetting gently with a wide-bore disposable Pasteur pipette; replace the strainer if it becomes clogged.

steps.title: Purify Nuclei via Percoll Gradient
steps.instruction: Separate nuclei using a Percoll gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Carefully overlay 3.5 mL of filtered nuclei suspension over each 75% Percoll solution, ensuring loaded tubes weigh exactly the same.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 10 °C with acceleration set to 9 (max) and deceleration set to 1 (min).
Using a light source behind the gradient, slowly collect the sample at the interphase (tight or fluffy band) using a glass Pasteur pipette.
Transfer the collected sample (approximately 4 mL) to a new 15 mL Falcon tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Final Wash and Storage
steps.instruction: Finalize the nuclei volume and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add enough NEB-A solution to the nuclei to reach a final volume of 10 mL.
Collect nuclei by centrifugation (refer to centrifugation parameters in step 5).
Estimate yield by weighing the tubes (subtracting empty tube weight).
Store the enriched nuclei sample at -80 °C until crosslinking steps of the Hi-C protocol.
